Application Data.NAME: Stationery Solutions, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Stationery Solutions, Inc. specializes in the distribution of high-quality stationery and paper products, including notebooks, writing instruments, and other office supplies. Our operations focus on providing a wide range of eco-friendly products to businesses and educational institutions while maintaining a robust inventory management system. With a centrally monitored alarm system in place to protect our inventory, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional customer service both in-store and through our online platform, ensuring that our clients receive the best products to meet their needs. We source our products exclusively from reputable suppliers to ensure quality and reliability.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
In the past three years, Stationery Solutions, Inc. experienced a total of two minor losses: 

1. **Loss Date:** 03/15/2021 
   **Cause:** Water damage due to a plumbing issue in the storage area. 
   **Amount:** $2,500 
   **Status:** Closed

2. **Loss Date:** 06/10/2022 
   **Cause:** Theft of inventory during a break-in, despite the alarm system being activated. 
   **Amount:** $4,000 
   **Status:** Closed 

The total losses amount to $6,500.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade I, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Centrally monitored alarm system with on-site security personnel during business hours and perimeter fencing to deter unauthorized access.
